title: AI Code Review Result
description: Structured output produced by the Claude Code AI reviewer for a single Pull Request. Consumed by the GitHub Actions workflow to render a summary comment, post inline review comments, and gate the PR on severity.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the reviewer targeted. Bump on breaking changes.

review.description: Optional metadata about the review context. The reviewer fills what it knows; the workflow may override with authoritative values.

base_ref.description: Target branch of the PR, e.g. 'main'.

commit_sha.description: HEAD commit SHA that was reviewed.

files_reviewed.description: Repo-relative paths the reviewer actually inspected.

rules_applied.description: Which .claude/rules/*.md files were loaded for this review.

overall_assessment.description: 2-4 sentence plain-language summary of the change and its overall quality.

summary.description: Roll-up counts and the recommended PR verdict. Used to gate the check.

recommendation.description: approve = no blocking issues; comment = non-blocking notes only; request_changes = at least one issue that should block merge.

counts.description: Number of findings at each severity. Must equal the counts in the findings array.

findings.description: All issues found, most severe first. Empty array means no issues.

positive_observations.description: Good practices worth highlighting. Not rendered as issues.

id.description: Stable ID for the finding, e.g. 'SEC-001', 'ARCH-002', 'TYPE-003'. Prefix groups by category.

severity.description: critical = security/breaking; medium = architecture/type-safety; minor = style/best-practice. Matches CLAUDE.md review priorities.

category.description: What kind of issue this is. Drives grouping and inline-comment labels.

title.description: Short one-line summary of the issue.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in, e.g. 'backend/src/main/java/com/example/UserController.java'.

line.description: 1-indexed line in the NEW version of the file where the issue anchors. Required to post an inline comment; omit only for whole-file/cross-file findings.

end_line.description: Optional last line of a multi-line span. Must be >= line.

rationale.description: Why it matters (impact, risk, which principle/rule it violates).

suggestion.description: How to fix it, in prose.

suggested_code.description: Optional corrected code snippet. Rendered as a fenced block / GitHub suggestion when it replaces the exact lines.

rule_source.description: Which guideline triggered this, e.g. 'security-review.md#injection-risks', 'java-review.md#business-logic', or an external ref like 'OWASP A03:2021'.

cwe.description: Optional CWE identifier for security findings, e.g. 'CWE-89' (SQL Injection).

confidence.description: How sure the reviewer is. Lets the workflow suppress low-confidence findings if desired.
